decision_conditions:
Detailed drawings and (where relevant) samples of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of relevant works:
- All new and replacement fireplaces including replacement or new hearths, fire baskets, surrounds, mantelpieces and grates;
- New doors, both internal and external, including detailed drawings at a minimum scale of 1:10, including sections at 1:5
- Internal elevations to show new joinery, cipboards, shelving, shutters, proposed changes to partition walls and any alterations to door and window openings
- Panelling to the hall and staircase
- Radiators, including their size, design, finish and proposed locations

REASON: To ensure that the proposed development is in keeping with the existing building (s) and does not prejudice the listed material of the building.
description: Erection of a lower ground floor rear extension with an external terrace above, reinstatement of a two storey infill extension to the front, other alterations to the property including associated internal modifications, reinstatement of fireplaces, repairs to chimneys, reinstatement of the original roof form, plus alterations to the rear garden.
